intro.en: Vehicle lighting harnesses distribute protected power, grounds and control signals to headlamps, daytime running lamps, fog lamps, front and rear combination lamps, side markers, licence lamps, interior lamps, work lamps and illuminated accessories. The category includes lamp pigtails, front-end and rear-body sub-harnesses, relay-and-fuse looms, LED driver leads, tailgate and door branches, test adapters and complete lighting kits.
intro.zh: 汽车灯线束向前照灯、日间行车灯、雾灯、前后组合灯、侧标志灯、牌照灯、车内灯、工作灯与发光附件分配受保护的电源、接地和控制信号。该小类覆盖灯具尾线、前端与后车身分线束、继电器保险线束、LED 驱动引线、尾门与车门分支、测试转接线及完整灯光套件。

knowledge.en: A lighting harness is not defined by a bulb socket alone. Lamp technology, optical function, circuit current, switching method, body controller, diagnostics, connector keying, route, thermal zone, sealing and destination-market requirements determine the released assembly. A connector that fits can still have the wrong pinout, ground strategy, load capacity or control architecture.
knowledge.zh: 汽车灯线束不能只凭灯泡插座定义。灯具技术、光学功能、回路电流、开关方式、车身控制器、诊断、连接器防错、走线、热区、密封与目标市场要求共同决定放行组件。连接器即使能插合，也可能存在针脚、接地策略、负载能力或控制架构错误。

notes.en: Provide vehicle or equipment identity; model year and market; lamp positions and technologies; lamp, bulb, driver and mating-connector data; system voltage; circuit and pin tables; continuous, inrush and fault current; fuse, relay, BCM, PWM or LIN control; ground strategy; route and branch datums; temperature, water, salt, vibration and flex exposure; drawings or samples; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆或设备身份、年款与市场、灯位与灯具技术、灯具、灯泡、驱动器和对插件资料、系统电压、回路与针脚表、持续、冲击与故障电流、保险、继电器、BCM、PWM 或 LIN 控制、接地策略、走线与分支基准、温度、水、盐、振动及弯折暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, branch datums, protection instructions, labels and test definitions. First articles are checked for mating, reach, lamp installation, current path, voltage drop and agreed functions before repeat production. Harness, lamp, vehicle configuration, fixture and inspection records remain linked by revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、分支基准、防护工艺、标签与测试定义。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、灯具装配、电流路径、压降与约定功能，线束、灯具、车辆配置、工装及检验记录按版本保持关联。

introduction.en: Engineer the Complete Lighting Path, Not Just the Lamp Plug
introduction.zh: 设计完整灯光路径，而不只是一个灯具插头

subtitle.en: Lamp families, protected power, intelligent control, sealing, routing and validation
subtitle.zh: 覆盖灯具家族、受保护供电、智能控制、密封、走线与验证

lead.en: Vehicle lighting is a family of power and signal assemblies spread across exposed body zones. A reliable design connects the energy source, protection, controller, branch network and each replaceable lamp as one documented system.
lead.zh: 汽车照明是分布在多个暴露车身区域的电源与信号组件家族。可靠设计把能源、保护、控制器、分支网络与每个可更换灯具作为一套有记录的系统连接起来。

title.en: One category covers visibility, signalling, identification and working illumination
title.zh: 同一小类覆盖照明、信号、识别与作业灯光

copy.en: Projects may include low and high beam headlamps, daytime running lamps, front position lamps, fog lamps, turn indicators, side repeaters, tail, stop, reverse and rear fog lamps, centre high-mounted stop lamps, markers, licence lamps, interior and ambient lighting, puddle lamps, cargo lamps and auxiliary work lights. Passenger cars, trucks, trailers, motorcycles, powersports and special vehicles divide these functions into different module boundaries. We can build a single pigtail, a lamp-to-body branch, a front or rear sub-harness, or a complete protected kit.
copy.zh: 项目可包含近光与远光前照灯、日间行车灯、前位灯、雾灯、转向灯、侧转向灯、尾灯、制动灯、倒车灯、后雾灯、高位制动灯、标志灯、牌照灯、车内与氛围灯、迎宾灯、货厢灯及辅助工作灯。乘用车、卡车、拖车、摩托车、动力运动设备与专用车辆会采用不同模块边界；我们既可制作单根尾线、灯具到车身分支，也可制作前后分线束或完整受保护套件。

copy.en: Similar lamp housings can contain different circuits, drivers and regional functions.
copy.zh: 外观相似的灯壳可能包含不同回路、驱动器与地区功能。

copy.en: Disconnect points follow vehicle assembly and realistic lamp service.
copy.zh: 断开点服从整车装配与真实灯具维修。

title.en: Wire size, fuse and relay strategy follow the complete electrical load
title.zh: 线径、保险与继电器策略服从完整电气负载

copy.en: Halogen filaments, HID ballasts, LED drivers and auxiliary light bars do not present the same steady-state, inrush or fault behaviour. Conductor size is calculated from current, route length, allowable voltage drop, ambient temperature, bundling and terminal limits. Fuses or circuit protection protect downstream conductors, while relays or electronic switches keep heavy lamp current away from low-current controls when the approved architecture requires it. Supply and return paths are reviewed together; a large positive cable cannot compensate for a weak ground.
copy.zh: 卤素灯丝、HID 镇流器、LED 驱动器与辅助灯条的稳态、冲击及故障行为并不相同。导体截面依据电流、路径长度、允许压降、环境温度、成束与端子限制计算；保险或回路保护用于保护下游导体，批准架构需要时通过继电器或电子开关避免大灯电流经过小电流控制端。供电与回流路径必须一起审核，粗正极线不能弥补薄弱接地。

copy.en: Both supply and ground resistance affect brightness and driver margin.
copy.zh: 供电与接地电阻都会影响亮度和驱动余量。

copy.en: Protection rating and location follow the smallest released downstream branch.
copy.zh: 保护额定值与位置服从下游最小放行分支。

title.en: LED modules and adaptive lamps add drivers, sensors and electronics interfaces
title.zh: LED 模组与自适应灯具增加驱动器、传感器与电子接口

copy.en: Modern lamp assemblies can integrate constant-current drivers, thermal sensing, levelling motors, shutters, matrix segments, welcome-light animations and replaceable or non-replaceable control modules. The harness must identify power, wake, ground, reference and communication circuits without assuming that every cavity is a simple lamp feed. Driver location, connector orientation, heat transfer, condensation path and service access influence branch length and strain relief. Module supply and signal return are kept consistent with the approved lamp and controller documentation.
copy.zh: 现代灯具可能集成恒流驱动、温度感知、调平电机、遮光机构、矩阵分区、迎宾动画以及可更换或不可更换控制模块。线束必须识别电源、唤醒、接地、参考与通信回路，不能把每个孔位都当成普通灯线。驱动器位置、接口方向、散热、冷凝路径与维修空间会影响分支长度和应力缓解；模块供电与信号回流要和批准的灯具及控制器资料一致。

copy.en: A multi-pin lamp may combine power, motor, sensor and communication paths.
copy.zh: 多针灯具可能同时包含电源、电机、传感与通信路径。

copy.en: Cable exits and clips stay clear of hot sinks, bulbs and exhaust paths.
copy.zh: 出线与卡扣避开散热体、灯泡与热气路径。

title.en: Direct switching, BCM outputs, PWM and LIN require different circuit construction
title.zh: 直接开关、BCM 输出、PWM 与 LIN 需要不同回路结构

copy.en: Conventional lamps may use direct or relay-switched power, while later vehicles can drive lamps through a body control module using high-side or low-side electronic outputs, pulse-width modulation, load monitoring or LIN communication. Some controllers detect open loads, shorts or unexpected current and may reject an apparently functional retrofit. We confirm control method, polarity, duty-cycle behaviour, network topology, termination where applicable and diagnostic expectations before releasing a replacement or accessory harness.
copy.zh: 传统灯具可能采用直接或继电器开关供电，较新的车辆则可由车身控制模块通过高边或低边电子输出、脉宽调制、负载监测或 LIN 通信驱动。部分控制器会检测开路、短路或异常电流，并可能拒绝看似能点亮的改装件。发布替换或附件线束前，需要确认控制方式、极性、占空比行为、网络拓扑、适用时的终端以及诊断预期。

title.en: Do not infer control from voltage alone
title.zh: 不能只凭电压推断控制

copy.en: A meter reading may hide PWM, diagnostics or switched-ground behaviour.
copy.zh: 万用表读数可能掩盖 PWM、诊断或开关接地行为。

copy.en: LIN or other data circuits remain traceable to controller and lamp address.
copy.zh: LIN 或其他数据回路保持可追溯到控制器与灯具地址。

title.en: External lamp connections need compatible sealing, drainage and assembly practice
title.zh: 外部灯具连接需要相容的密封、排水与装配工艺

copy.en: Headlamp, bumper, wheel-arch, underbody, tailgate and rear-lamp zones face different combinations of rain, spray, road salt, washdown, dust and temperature cycling. Housing, terminal, wire seal, cavity plug, lock, mating part, backshell and cable exit must form one compatible system. Routes avoid upward-facing cavities and water traps, coverings are overlapped and drained deliberately, and splices are positioned away from persistent moisture. A sealed connector does not make the complete harness waterproof by itself.
copy.zh: 前照灯、保险杠、轮拱、底部、尾门与后灯区域面对的雨水、飞溅、道路盐、冲洗、粉尘和温度循环组合不同。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、锁止、对插件、尾壳与出线必须构成一套相容系统；走线避免孔腔朝上与积水，覆盖层进行有意搭接和排水，接续点远离持续潮湿位置。单独一个密封连接器不能让整根线束自动具备防水能力。

copy.en: A correct housing can still leak when terminal, seal and cable ranges differ.
copy.zh: 即使壳体正确，端子、线封与线缆范围不匹配仍会泄漏。

copy.en: Drainage and vent strategy are reviewed with the lamp assembly.
copy.zh: 排水与通气策略需结合灯具总成审核。

title.en: Front-end, bumper, body, door and tailgate routes each impose different movement
title.zh: 前端、保险杠、车身、车门与尾门走线各有不同运动要求

copy.en: A front lighting harness may pass radiator supports, crash structures, washer reservoirs, fans and hot engine-bay surfaces. Rear branches can cross quarter panels, boot lids, liftgates, hinges, removable lamps and body-builder interfaces. We identify fixed and moving ends, full opening travel, bend direction, clip datums, sharp edges, impact zones, service positions and lamp removal path. Controlled loops provide necessary movement without leaving cable to rub, snag or load the connector.
copy.zh: 前灯线束可能经过水箱支架、防撞结构、清洗液壶、风扇与发动机舱热表面；后部支路可能跨越侧围、行李厢盖、尾门、铰链、可拆灯具与上装接口。设计要识别固定端和运动端、完整开启行程、弯曲方向、卡扣基准、锐边、碰撞区、维修位置及拆灯路径；受控余环只提供所需运动，不允许线缆摩擦、挂碰或把载荷传给连接器。

copy.en: Service reach and disconnect access are included in released geometry.
copy.zh: 维修可达与断开空间纳入放行几何。

copy.en: Hinge loops bend in a defined plane and stay supported at both ends.
copy.zh: 铰链余环在规定平面弯曲，并在两端获得支撑。

title.en: Bulb sockets, sealed housings, terminals and splices are released as complete systems
title.zh: 灯座、密封壳体、端子与接续按完整体系放行

copy.en: Lighting assemblies can use bulb sockets, sealed automotive connectors, board-to-wire interfaces, ring terminals, junctions, fuse holders, relay bases and overmolded splitters. Each contact must match conductor material and size, insulation diameter, seal range, cavity and mating contact. Crimp geometry, strip length, seal position, insertion depth, secondary lock, splice method and strain relief are defined before coverings hide them. High-temperature lamp areas may need specified socket, wire and sleeve constructions rather than a visually similar substitute.
copy.zh: 灯光组件可使用灯泡座、密封汽车连接器、板线接口、环形端子、接线点、保险座、继电器座与注塑分线器。每个接触件都要匹配导体材料和截面、绝缘外径、线封范围、孔位及对插接触件；压接几何、剥线长度、线封位置、插入深度、二次锁、接续方法与应力缓解在覆盖前明确。灯具高温区可能需要指定灯座、线材与套管结构，不能用外观相似件替代。

copy.en: Crimps, seals and splices are verified before tape, conduit or molding.
copy.zh: 压接、线封与接续在胶带、波纹管或注塑遮蔽前核验。

copy.en: Connector keying and lock condition are checked with the actual lamp side.
copy.zh: 连接器防错与锁止状态需结合真实灯具端检查。

title.en: Existing lamps and harnesses can guide development without copying unknown faults
title.zh: 现有灯具与线束可指导开发，但不能复制未知缺陷

copy.en: A sample can reveal connector family, branch station, clip orientation, coverings and point-to-point circuits. It may also contain heat damage, corrosion, repairs, missing seals, modified loads or market-specific wiring. We record sample condition, identify the lamp and mating vehicle equipment, trace every circuit, compare left and right variants and isolate uncertainty. Approved corrections and substitutions become controlled drawing revisions before the first article is installed and functionally reviewed.
copy.zh: 样品能够呈现连接器家族、分支站位、卡扣方向、覆盖层与点对点回路，也可能带有热损伤、腐蚀、维修、缺失线封、改动负载或市场专用布线。我们记录样品状态，识别灯具与车辆对插设备，追踪每条回路，对照左右侧变型并隔离不确定性；批准修正与替代在首件装车和功能审核前转化为受控图纸版本。

copy.en: Burnt sockets, roadside repairs and missing clips are documented, not reproduced.
copy.zh: 烧蚀灯座、路边维修与缺失卡扣被记录，而不是复制。

title.en: Manage left, right and market variants
title.zh: 管理左右侧与市场变型

copy.en: Similar branches retain distinct circuit, label and revision identities.
copy.zh: 相似分支仍保持独立回路、标签与版本身份。

title.en: A good lighting harness installs in sequence and remains diagnosable later
title.zh: 良好的灯光线束能够顺序装配，也便于后续诊断

copy.en: Branch order, clip direction, grommet seating, connector access and label visibility influence assembly time and error risk. Interfaces near bumpers and lamps should be reachable without pulling on wires, and service loops should permit intended removal without contacting tyres, fans or hot parts. Repeated left-right connectors use physical keying, labels or controlled geometry so that installation does not rely on memory. Diagnostic access and replaceable module boundaries are considered before the form-board layout is frozen.
copy.zh: 分支顺序、卡扣方向、护圈就位、接口可达与标签可见性会影响装配时间和错误风险。保险杠与灯具附近接口应无需拉拽导线即可触及，维修余量允许按预定方式拆卸，同时避开轮胎、风扇与热部件。重复的左右侧连接器通过物理防错、标签或受控几何识别，装配不能依赖记忆；在布线板布局冻结前就考虑诊断可达与可更换模块边界。

copy.en: Keying, labels and branch geometry reinforce the same installation intent.
copy.zh: 防错、标签与分支几何共同强化同一装配意图。

copy.en: Disconnect and lamp-removal forces do not transfer into crimps or splices.
copy.zh: 断开与拆灯力不传递到压接或接续。

title.en: Repeatability depends on drawings, tooling, staged inspection and traceable variants
title.zh: 重复性依赖图纸、工装、分段检查与可追溯变型

copy.en: Released drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, form-board datums, work instructions and test definitions control production. Wire preparation, seal loading, crimping, splicing, connector insertion, secondary locks, coverings, clips and labels receive staged checks before they become hidden. Variant-specific fixtures and visual references prevent left-right, lamp-type and market configurations from being mixed. Changes to lamp, terminal, wire or controller data are reviewed before material substitution.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、布线板基准、作业指导与测试定义共同控制生产。剥线、穿线封、压接、接续、插壳、二次锁、覆盖、卡扣和标签在被遮蔽前分阶段检查；变型专用工装与视觉基准避免左右侧、灯型与市场配置混料，灯具、端子、线材或控制器资料变化在替料前完成审核。

copy.en: Drawing, fixture, label and test program identify the same lamp configuration.
copy.zh: 图纸、工装、标签与测试程序识别同一灯具配置。

copy.en: Critical terminations are accepted before covers prevent inspection.
copy.zh: 关键端接在覆盖层阻碍检查前完成验收。

title.en: Continuity, electrical performance and vehicle behaviour are different evidence levels
title.zh: 导通、电气性能与整车行为属于不同证据层级

copy.en: Routine inspection can verify material identity, dimensions, cavity population, continuity, shorts and workmanship. Project validation can add crimp pull, circuit resistance, voltage drop under load, insulation, sealing, thermal, vibration, flex, connector cycling or corrosion tests only against approved methods and limits. Powered checks confirm specified lamp functions, switching, PWM or network response and diagnostics with representative equipment. Passing continuity alone does not prove beam performance, waterproofing or complete vehicle compatibility.
copy.zh: 常规检验可核对物料身份、尺寸、装针、导通、短路与工艺。项目验证可依据批准方法和限值增加压接拉力、回路电阻、负载压降、绝缘、密封、温度、振动、弯折、接口插拔或腐蚀测试；上电检查使用有代表性的设备确认规定灯光功能、开关、PWM 或网络响应与诊断。通过导通并不能单独证明光束性能、防水或完整整车兼容性。

copy.en: Harness checks, lamp checks and complete-vehicle checks are reported separately.
copy.zh: 线束检查、灯具检查与整车检查分别报告。

copy.en: Voltage, load, controller and diagnostic conditions match the released project.
copy.zh: 电压、负载、控制器与诊断条件匹配放行项目。

q.en: Is a vehicle lighting harness a universal product?
q.zh: 汽车灯线束是通用产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad family of lamp pigtails, front and rear sub-harnesses, protected power looms, control leads and complete kits. Vehicle, market, lamp technology, pinout, load, controller and route determine the released version.
a.zh: 不是。它是灯具尾线、前后分线束、受保护电源线束、控制引线与完整套件组成的广泛家族，车辆、市场、灯具技术、针脚、负载、控制器与走线共同决定放行版本。

q.en: Can a matching lamp connector prove compatibility?
q.zh: 灯具连接器能插合就能证明兼容吗？

a.en: No. Connector keying does not prove pin assignment, terminal rating, ground strategy, lamp load, PWM, diagnostics or LIN compatibility. These must be verified against the actual lamp and vehicle system.
a.zh: 不能。连接器防错不能证明针脚定义、端子额定值、接地策略、灯具负载、PWM、诊断或 LIN 兼容性，必须结合真实灯具与车辆系统核对。

q.en: Can you build harnesses for halogen, HID and LED lamps?
q.zh: 可以制作卤素、HID 与 LED 灯线束吗？

a.en: Yes, when lamp, ballast or driver data and the vehicle control architecture are defined. Their current, heat, switching and diagnostic behaviour differ, so the same wire and relay assumptions do not apply to every technology.
a.zh: 可以，但需要明确灯具、镇流器或驱动器资料及车辆控制架构。不同技术的电流、热、开关和诊断行为不同，不能全部套用同一线径与继电器假设。

q.en: Does a sealed lamp connector make the whole harness waterproof?
q.zh: 密封灯具连接器能让整根线束防水吗？

a.en: No. Housing, terminal, seal, cavity plug, mating part, cable exit, splice, covering, drainage, route and assembly quality must work together under a defined exposure and validation condition.
a.zh: 不能。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、对插件、出线、接续、覆盖层、排水、走线与装配质量必须在规定暴露和验证条件下共同工作。

q.en: Can an old lamp harness be used to develop a replacement?
q.zh: 可以依据旧灯光线束开发替换件吗？

a.en: Yes, as one evidence source. Heat damage, corrosion, repairs, missing seals, modified lamps and left-right or market differences still need review against the lamp, vehicle and circuit data before release.
a.zh: 可以把旧样品作为一类证据，但热损伤、腐蚀、维修、缺失线封、改装灯具以及左右侧或市场差异仍需结合灯具、车辆和回路资料审核后才能放行。

q.en: What should be provided for quotation and sampling?
q.zh: 报价与打样需要提供什么？

a.en: Send vehicle and market identity, lamp positions and technologies, lamp and mating-connector data, voltage, pinout, loads, fuse or controller architecture, route photographs, branch dimensions, thermal and weather exposure, drawings or sample, labels, quantity and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供车辆与市场身份、灯位与灯具技术、灯具与对插件资料、电压、针脚、负载、保险或控制器架构、走线照片、分支尺寸、热与天气暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量和所需验证。
